mapper.select: select coalesce(max(source_id),0) from integration_schema.exchange_rate where source_system='SAP'
select * from integration_schema.exchange_rate where jsonb_build_array(rate_type,from_currency,to_currency,effective_date::text) in cast(#{key} as jsonb) for update
select * from integration_schema.exchange_rate where source_system='SAP' and source_id in #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into integration_schema.exchange_rate as target (source_system,source_id,rate_type,from_currency,to_currency,effective_date,raw_rate,from_factor,to_factor,quotation_method,normalized_rate,blocked,enabled,is_deleted,source_updated_at,payload_hash) values (#{row.sourceSystem},#{row.sourceId},#{row.rateType},#{row.fromCurrency},#{row.toCurrency},#{row.effectiveDate},#{row.rawRate},#{row.fromFactor},#{row.toFactor},#{row.quotationMethod},#{row.normalizedRate},#{row.blocked},#{row.enabled},#{row.isDeleted},#{row.sourceUpdatedAt},#{row.payloadHash}) on conflict(source_system,source_id) do update set raw_rate=excluded.raw_rate, from_factor=excluded.from_factor, to_factor=excluded.to_factor, quotation_method=excluded.quotation_method, normalized_rate=excluded.normalized_rate, blocked=excluded.blocked, enabled=excluded.enabled, is_deleted=excluded.is_deleted, source_updated_at=excluded.source_updated_at, payload_hash=excluded.payload_hash,synced_at=clock_timestamp() where target.source_updated_at <=< excluded.source_updated_at
mapper.select: select count(*) from integration_schema.exchange_rate where (from_currency ilike #{search} or to_currency ilike #{search})
select * from integration_schema.exchange_rate where (from_currency ilike #{search} or to_currency ilike #{search}) order by id limit #{size} offset #{offset}
